text:
alex: Quick FYI — I'm planning a routing smokecheck tonight at 21:00 UTC. Goal: run a short load test against batch inference and temporarily lower pager sensitivity for batch-gpu/high-latency alerts for ~30m so we don't get noisy pages while we validate autoscaling. No active incident. @priya @matt can you ACK? I'll post exact config and rollback commands here.

priya: ack — thanks for the heads up. will this change dedicated customers' pages or only hosted/default routing?

alex: Only hosted/default routing. Dedicated customers with label `strict_sla=true` will be excluded. Planned change (summary): convert severity: page -> ticket for the batch_gpu_high_latency rule for 21:00-21:30 UTC.

alex: config snippet (will apply as a temp overlay):
```
# alert rule name: batch_gpu_high_latency
expr: p95(batch_inference_latency_seconds{job="batch"}) > 1.2
for: 5m
labels:
  service: batch-inference
  severity: page
# temp overlay (applied 21:00-21:30):
labels:
  severity: ticket
```

matt: can you paste the exact kubectl/terraform command for rollback? and pls add a short note in the handoff doc so overnight oncall knows this is expected behavior.

alex: rollback command will be:
```
kubectl apply -f /opt/routing/overlays/pre-smokecheck-1725101234.yaml && ./scripts/restore-routing.sh --tag pre-smokecheck-1725101234
```
I'll also push an entry into the oncall handoff doc (handoff section: Batch GPU smokecheck — change + rollback + prometheus query).

jordan: I'm picking up the overnight rotation at 22:00 — I can monitor if needed. which channels will receive anything during the window? will eng-oncall get any new traffic?

alex: With the temp change severity goes to ticket so pages should not hit eng-oncall. Standard pager path (severity=page) stays unchanged for other rules. For clarity:
- severity=page -> eng-oncall (unchanged rules)
- batch_gpu_high_latency during 21:00-21:30 -> severity=ticket -> eng-alerts channel / ticketing
I'll add that exact routing line to the handoff doc.

oncall-bot: scheduled change: routing overlay apply at 21:00 UTC by alex. scheduled rollback at 21:30 UTC. metadata: smokecheck-batch-gpu-1725101234.

priya: please add the Prometheus query link + runbook pointer to the handoff so people can quickly triage if we see unexpected behavior.

alex: done. links added to handoff: https://prometheus.internal/graph?g0.expr=p95(batch_inference_latency_seconds) and runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/batch-gpu-latency. I'll post live updates when I apply the overlay.

matt: :thumbsup: I'll stay reachable in case anything noisy slips through.

jordan: ACK. thanks for the clear plan.

alex: thanks all — kicking off at 21:00. will report back with apply + revert logs.
